It is derived from the Arabic root word "sadqa," which means "to give" or "to offer" something sincerely. The name signifies a person who is steadfast in their faith, true to their beliefs, and strives to help others in need. The spiritual journey of a person named Sadiq is focused on capturing the essence of truth and seeking to align oneself with it, ultimately leading to a deeper connection with Allah.
